posts.text: Q1 fy27 Looks like things are falling in place as per the plan and this is clearly reflected in Q1 fy27 results. There has been a significant improvement in margins during Q1, driven by multiple initiatives such as LNG gas supply from Equinor at lower rate, lower cost of making Ammonia vs higher spot price, B2c value chain etc. image 1530×1186 245 KB The company expects annual cost savings of around ₹300 crore from the Equinor gas contract.
